recovery_note: Exact numeric rows transcribed from the Appendix tables, PDF pages 69-73 (printed pages 55-59). No figure digitization, interpolation, or inferred values.
facility_note: The thesis describes Aerospace Corporation and the Aul/Petersen facility, but Appendix rows are not facility-labeled; facility is therefore explicitly not_stated_per_appendix_row.
adjustment_note: The table reports adjusted average T/P alongside original P/T. tau_ign is retained as printed; adjustment_status does not claim the delay itself was adjusted.
provenance_policy: These are measured Zinner shock-tube table rows, distinct from Burke 2015 plot/supplement data; do not treat them as the complete Burke dataset.
